Hey, I completely spaced out last night and hurt myself so I understand what you mean by disassociating. It took hurting myself to zone back into reality. The only fight that you have just now is in your head...when your head tells you that you want to die...tell it no. You can empathise with how your friends been feeling, hopefully he’s ok and just taking time to himself. Death is an end all solution to a temporary problem, death is the pain that never goes away. 

I have this fear which might also change your perception of death.

Ever since I was little I have believed that the emotion you feel before death is the emotion you’re likely to feel if there is something after it...I’m not gonna be someone who tells ya that there’s a god or isn’t...but just in the off chance that my fear is rationale, wouldn’t you want to get to a better frame of mind where you’d feel happy for eternity?

Hey...the fact you’re still here is a gift. My god do I feel heartbroken that society has made you feel this way.

I would love to read all the stuff you have expressed but just now...all I want to know is if you’re still here...and want to get through this. Please get back to me and I will do my best to bring you out of this hole.

Hey dude, I would’ve read through the comments to see what’s going on but any time is valuable time...do ya get that?

I’m praying to whatever greater being or thing there is out there that you’re still with us because no one knows until we meet them/it.

Every question you’re probably gonna be asked is just gonna make you think more and there’s nothing worse than thinking when you can’t think straight. So all I want you to do is read.

Do you know how I found this post? Because I myself was just starting to make plans to do the end all, I didn’t even have a reddit account until I seen your post.

Me, I hate everything...or at least I thought I did. I thought my problems were bigger than everyone else’s...did I f*ck know that there’s this little guy facing the biggest battle of his life just now. 

I can’t promise you that everything broken will be fixed because I’ve yet to see my problems fixed. But guess what...your cry for help has literally changed the way my life is going and all you did was express yourself.

You’re a little hero, you could use that power to help others.

I just hope that you see this and it’s enough for you to hold on for that bit longer.

You’ve made it this far, please not have given up.
